description: JVM host ABI slice (ISSUE-0100). JVM-only multi-module fixtures: each fixture writes its 'modules' (relative .deal paths, including the host .d.deal declarations) plus 'entry' under a temp project root, and — when the fixture declares 'hosts' — a real deal.json whose externals map wires each raw host import path to its declaration (the spec manifest form). The runner then executes the real whole-project pipeline: CompilationOrchestrator with Backend.JVM (externals-gated host resolution, module discovery, signature extraction, dependency ordering, name resolution, type checking, per-module JvmBackend codegen) → the host implementation classes are compiled with javac together with every emitted .java artifact plus a runner class → java executes the emitted artifacts (the harness fails a fixture whose parser/checker/module-discovery yields no compile, whose codegen leaves no artifact, whose host implementation is missing, or whose JVM execution is bypassed). Covered host ABI forms (spec-v1.2 §Modules, declarations, standard library, and host ABI + §JVM value mapping): declared export exposure through load-time-validated reflective wrappers, missing declared exports as load-time E8011 errors, extra host exports ignored, sync return boundary checks (E8010 for wrong runtime kinds, including Java null crossing a non-nullable boundary — the spec's no-unvalidated-null rule), nullable returns accepting Java null as the DEAL null sentinel, the null return boundary (E8010 for a non-null host result), the int safe-range return boundary (E8004), host function parameter adaptation (declared primitive/string/nullable parameters arriving as their JVM mappings), async host operation shape checks (E8010 for a non-operation), async completion value checks (E8001 at the await site, with the spec-permitted blocking JVM await lowering), and one frontend E2009 compile-error gate rejected before any backend. Host class exports stay E6000 in this slice.

tests.name: jvm-host-export-presence
tests.description: A host module's declared exports are exposed through load-time-validated wrappers: main() calls info() through the boundary and run() computes add() through the boundary (DEAL v1.2 has no module-level statements, so the v1.1 load-time call moved into main())

modules.bindings/log.d.deal:
export function info(level: int, s: string): null;
export function add(a: int, b: int): int;

tests.name: jvm-host-missing-export
tests.description: A host module whose class lacks a declared export fails at module load with E8011 — the load-time error fires from the import's presence check before any function runs

tests.name: jvm-host-missing-host-class
tests.description: A host import whose implementation class cannot be loaded fails at module load with E8011 (the JVM analog of LuaJIT's wrapped require failure)

tests.name: jvm-host-extra-export-ignored
tests.description: Extra host exports are structurally dropped: the host class supplies an undeclared extra() method and the load succeeds with the declared surface intact

tests.name: jvm-host-bad-return
tests.description: A host function returning a value of the wrong runtime kind for its declared return type raises E8010 at the call boundary (Long for a declared string)

tests.name: jvm-host-bad-return-null-for-string
tests.description: Java null crossing the untyped host boundary into a non-nullable return raises E8010 — the spec forbids exposing Java null as DEAL null without validation

tests.name: jvm-host-int-out-of-range-return
tests.description: A host function returning an out-of-DEAL-safe-range int raises E8004 at the call boundary (checkInt mirrors LuaJIT's int boundary)

tests.name: jvm-host-nullable-return-ok
tests.description: A host function declared string | null returns Java null (the JVM DEAL null sentinel) and a string across calls; DEAL narrowing observes both

modules.bindings/log.d.deal: export function find(s: string): string | null;

tests.name: jvm-host-nullable-return-bad
tests.description: A host function declared string | null returning a non-null non-string value raises E8010 (the nullable boundary checks the inner type)

modules.bindings/log.d.deal: export function find(s: string): string | null;

tests.name: jvm-host-null-return-ok
tests.description: A host function declared ->null returning Java null passes the null boundary on both the main() discard path and an in-function call

tests.name: jvm-host-null-return-bad
tests.description: A host function declared ->null returning a non-null value raises E8010 at the boundary (LuaJIT's sync ->null check, JVM null sentinel)

tests.name: jvm-host-param-adaptation
tests.description: Host function parameter adaptation: declared int/number/boolean/string parameters arrive as their JVM mappings and a nullable parameter receives Java null (the DEAL null) and a value across calls

modules.bindings/log.d.deal:
export function combine(a: int, b: number, c: boolean, d: string): string;
export function maybe(s: string | null): string;

tests.name: jvm-host-async-ok
tests.description: A host function declared async returns a CompletableFuture (the backend async operation); await joins it and the completion value satisfies the declared return type — including a DEAL async function awaited through another

modules.bindings/log.d.deal: export async function fetch(id: int): string;

tests.name: jvm-host-async-shape-bad
tests.description: A host function declared async returning a non-operation raises E8010 (the async operation shape check, spec: the host must return a backend async operation accepted by the await lowering)

tests.name: jvm-host-async-completion-bad
tests.description: A host async operation completing with a value that does not satisfy the declared return type raises E8001 at the await site (the LuaJIT await-site completion check)

tests.name: jvm-host-frontend-gate-e2009
tests.description: A bare host import whose on-disk declaration is not listed in deal.json externals is a frontend E2009 compile error rejected before any backend (no .java artifact, no codegen)
